scriptVariables.finding: The tranche-3 lane bodies reference ZERO bare script variables. Every shared manager var they touch already routes through a Manager accessor (GetActiveDeity, GetSuppressCurseTransitionOutputs, GetRaceCurseSurfaceShown, GetQrQueueTransactionActive, GetQrQueueNeedsBretonRewardSync, SetRaceCurseSurfaceShown, SetQrQueueNeedsBretonRewardSync), per the tranche-3 header comment in the base. No declaration had to move and no new base accessor pair is needed for t3.

interfaceGaps.note: Findings against the FROZEN 19-verb surface. Nothing here was forced; each item is either unimplementable at the frozen signature or implemented with a documented, behaviour-visible compromise.

handleContextualSignalHasNoReasonSlot.detail: Bool HandleContextualSignal(String signalId, Form contextForm = None, Float magnitude = 0.0) has no String payload. Every t3 Handle* body takes a String reason, and live callers compose it dynamically (PDV_EventBus: "eventbus_" + eventType + "_" + sourceId; PDV_DevotionLedger: "taboo_" + sourceTag). The dispatch layer synthesizes reason = "signal_" + signalId. Reasons are provenance only (StorageUtil PDV.Breton.LastKnightlyVowReason, PDV.Redguard.LastSectReason, ledger entry text) -- the dedupe/anti-farm keys are separate literals -- but this IS a diff and must not be read as a verbatim move.
handleContextualSignalHasNoReasonSlot.recommendedFix: Add String reason = "" to HandleContextualSignal on the base.

zeroArgLifecycleVerbs.detail: ApplyInitialChoice() and ApplyCurseHandlers() are declared zero-arg on the base, but every race implementation and every live call site carries arguments: ApplyBretonInitialChoice(Int traditionValue, String reason) / ApplyRedguardInitialChoice(Int sectValue, String reason) called from PDV__ManagerQuest.psc:7546-7548; ApplyBretonCurseHandlers(Int oldState, Int newState, String reason) / ApplyRedguardCurseHandlers(Int, Int, String) called from PDV_DevotionLedger.psc:4244,4256. NOT overridden in either adapter.
zeroArgLifecycleVerbs.recommendedFix: ApplyInitialChoice(Int optionValue, String reason) and ApplyCurseHandlers(Int oldState, Int newState, String reason) on the base.

formalCommitmentOfferMessageTypeMismatch.detail: Base declares String GetFormalCommitmentOfferMessage() (zero-arg). Both race equivalents are Message GetXFormalCommitmentOfferMessage(PDV_DeityBase deity), and PDV_DevotionLedger.psc:3920-3922 returns the Message record. A String return cannot carry a Message form. NOT overridden in either adapter.
formalCommitmentOfferMessageTypeMismatch.recommendedFix: Message Function GetFormalCommitmentOfferMessage(PDV_DeityBase deity) on the base.

handleLocationChangeIsZeroArg.severity: resolved in-adapter, but note the shape
handleLocationChangeIsZeroArg.detail: HandleLocationChange() carries no Location, yet PDV_ActionRouter.psc:321,323 needs akNewLocation AND akOldLocation. Redguard instead routes both through HandleContextualSignal using contextForm (Location extends Form), so no behaviour is lost and HandleLocationChange is deliberately left un-overridden. If the base later gains HandleLocationChange(Location akNew, Location akOld), fold the two signal ids into it.

showOriginNotificationNotWired.detail: ShowOriginNotification(String messageKey) is not overridden. Breton has no notification verb; Redguard has ShowRedguardNotification(Message messageRecord, String fallbackText) and ShowRedguardMessage(Message, String, Bool), both internal-only (no cross-boundary caller). A messageKey -> Message table would be invented surface, so it was not built.

keyedDetailAccessorParamNameCollision.detail: The base declares GetOriginDetailLabel(String key) / GetOriginDetailValue(String key). `Key` is a vanilla Papyrus script type (Key extends MiscObject), so any override that actually READS the parameter fails to compile with "key is not a variable". The base's inert defaults never read it, which is why the base compiles. Both adapters rename the parameter to detailKey (Papyrus matches override signatures by type, not by parameter name). Every other adapter will hit this.

detailAccessorsAreCurrentStateOnly.detail: GetOriginDetailLabel/Value carry no numeric argument, so Breton's "tradition-tier" / "practice-tier" / "practice-count" keys resolve against GetBretonTraditionValue() (the CURRENT tradition). PDV__ManagerQuest.psc:8037,8061,9979 already call exactly that way, but :4545,:4554 pass an arbitrary traditionValue and cannot be remapped to the keyed accessor.
